title: Rerun signed index v1
description: The bundle index.json (ADR 0024, docs/02-topo-format.md "Signed index"). Each item of topos validates against topo.schema.json, each item of packages against package.schema.json (checked by the workbench tests); the client checks the Ed25519 signature over the raw bytes before parsing.

seq.description: Monotonic; the client refuses one lower than the last it accepted, and the same number with other bytes.

topos.description: Released Topos (never status draft, never TODO), sorted by id.

packages.description: Released packages (never status draft, never TODO), sorted by id.
